tools.name: fuko_tag_text
tools.title: Tag text with FUKO-LANG symbols
tools.description: Run the KK1 Core FUKO-LANG tagger over an arbitrary text and return the detected tokens (agent, executable tool, workflow, guardrail, skill, condition) with their character offsets, suggested FUKO form, and confidence.

text.description: Raw text (any of EN/PL/FR/ES) to analyze.

tools.name: list_telegram_messages
tools.title: List imported Telegram messages
tools.description: Return the most recent Telegram messages ingested by KK1 Core, including their FUKO tag tokens. Requires authentication.

limit.description: How many of the most recent messages to return (1-200).

tools.name: system_status
tools.title: KK1 Core system status
tools.description: Report the KK1 Core Telegram ingestion health: webhook activity, error counter, and number of stored messages.
